name: Conduct
overview: Scripture teaches that conduct reflects the condition of the heart and the believer’s relationship with God, as seen in the call to serve the Lord with joy and gladness (Deuteronomy 28:47). Even a child’s actions reveal their character, highlighting the importance of guidance and correction (Proverbs 20:11; 29:15). Jesus' teachings challenge believers to move beyond strict retributive justice and judgment of others, emphasizing love for God and neighbor as the foundation for righteous living (Matthew 5:38; 7:1; Luke 10:27). Thus, Christian conduct is marked by joyful obedience, wise discipline, mercy, and wholehearted love.
